notes.title: 【Wei】Countdown: 1 Day Until Launch
notes.content: [p]【Wei】Countdown: 1 Day Until Launch[/p][p]Less than one day until the full version of Wei is released.[/p][p]On August 31, 2025, at 14:00, dive into an unpredictable whirlwind of romance—exclusively on Steam.[/p][p]Will it be tender sweetness… or hidden danger? The choice is yours to make.[/p][p]You and them—destined to cross paths at last.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45201083/7027f38b908ee5559867b40899507ec227ce981e.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Demo Update: UI & Visuals Revamped!
notes.content: [p]Greetings, Players![/p][p]In this demo update, we've rolled out multiple visual and interface optimizations, aligning with the official version's UI to enhance your gaming experience! Here are the key highlights:[/p][p]1. Home Screen Upgrade:[/p][p]Revamped visuals for a sleeker look! Smoother navigation and eye-catching aesthetics.[/p][p]2. Dialogue Experience Enhanced:[/p][p]Redesigned dialogue interface for better readability and clearer storytelling.[/p][p]3. NEW Feature: CG Gallery![/p][p]Relive stunning game moments anytime in the all-new CG Gallery![/p][p]4. Character Art Updates:[/p][p]Optimized illustrations for two highly-discussed characters—subtle but impactful tweaks now live![/p][p]Jump back in and try the new updates~[/p][p]We can’t wait to hear your thoughts! Drop your feedback in the comments—your insights fuel our progress![/p][p]Happy Gaming! (≧∇≦)ﾉ[/p]
